title: regelspraak-ir-v0
description: Structural schema for the 'regelspraak-ir-v0' format: the faithful engine-neutral JSON dump of the reference frontend's fully resolved model (mirror-then-diverge; see spec/IR-SPEC.md). Every object is closed (additionalProperties:false) and lists every always-emitted key as required; node subtypes are discriminated on the 'node' field. Exception, by the decided wire-entry discipline (IR-SPEC, Method): extension fields carrying v1 deltas (verbindendeRol, bronRol, the symbolic fact-creation fields) are optional, the datatype union admits the extension node SumType (the payload-carrying variant family, CONSTRUCTS row 36), and the expr union admits the extension nodes TemporalRead, Construct, Match and BinderRef — the v0 emitter never produces any of them, and when present they are written whole, never null. Section citations (e.g. §13.3.3) point into the source language spec by number only.

defaultLadders.description: Extension list (v1, Phase 4): default ladders (characteristic and attribute forms) per spec/RUNTIME-SEMANTICS.md ch. 7. Optional; the v0 emitter never produces it.

SumType.description: Extension node (IR-SPEC Method; wire node SumType, never emitter-produced): the payload-carrying variant family of CONSTRUCTS row 36 — a declared, nominal sum type hosted by 'domeinen' and repeated whole at every use site. Each constructor carries a 'name' and either one 'payload' datatype (unary) or null (nullary). See spec/IR-SPEC.md ch. 2.4 (WF-060/061).

Eenheid.description: A unit: abbreviation, declaring system, canonical unit and conversion factor; 'noemer' is the denominator unit of a composite rate (§13.3.3.2), else null.

navigatieBindingen.description: Extension field (wire-entry discipline, IR-SPEC Method): the navigation hops as symbolic role bindings, subject-outward, one binding per hop — the bound role is the role the hop reaches (the far role). Written whole or not at all, never null.

ExprOnopgelost.description: An expression the resolver could not resolve; surfaces as an explicit marker.

TemporalRead.description: Extension node (v1, CONSTRUCTS row 11): the point-in-time read read(tl, d) of spec/RUNTIME-SEMANTICS.md ch. 3.3. Never emitter-produced; basis, datum and type are required and non-null.

Construct.description: Extension node (IR-SPEC Method; wire node Construct, never emitter-produced): builds a sum-type constructor value (CONSTRUCTS row 36; spec/RUNTIME-SEMANTICS.md ch. 9.1). 'argument' is an expr iff the constructor is unary, null for a nullary constructor. 'type' (the SumType) is required and non-null.

Match.description: Extension node (IR-SPEC Method; wire node Match, never emitter-produced): deconstructs a sum-type value, one arm per declared constructor (CONSTRUCTS row 36; spec/RUNTIME-SEMANTICS.md ch. 9.2). A unary arm carries a 'binder' name, a nullary arm carries null. 'type' (the result datatype) and 'scrutinee' are required and non-null.

BinderRef.description: Extension node (IR-SPEC Method; wire node BinderRef, never emitter-produced): reads the nearest enclosing match-arm binder of its name (CONSTRUCTS row 36; spec/RUNTIME-SEMANTICS.md ch. 9.2). Deliberately distinct from VariabeleRef (row 24). 'name' and 'type' are required and non-null.

TekstReeksDeel.description: A part of a text sequence: a literal fragment or an interpolated expression.

navigatieBinding.description: Extension field (wire-entry discipline, IR-SPEC Method): the one navigation hop of a navigated characteristic check as a symbolic role binding — the bound role is the role the hop reaches. Written whole or not at all, never null.

ConditieOnopgelost.description: A condition the resolver could not resolve; surfaces as an explicit marker.

Geldigheid.description: A validity window; 'vanaf'/'tot' are ISO dates or null for open-ended.

besluit.description: Characteristic ladders only: attribute (true) or do-not-attribute (false); null on attribute rungs.

voorwaarde.description: The justification; null only on the initialisation rung (its justification is input-emptiness, ch. 7.3).

consequentie.description: Attribute ladders only: the rung's value; a leeg-evaluating consequence falls through.

initialisatie.description: The initialisation rung (lowest only): justified iff the target is empty in the input facts.

attribuut.description: Attribute-ladder target; a ladder carries exactly one of kenmerk/attribuut (WF-050).

ongeordend.description: Declared-unordered (ch. 7.2): multiple ladders on one target are admissible iff every one carries this marking; differing simultaneous decisions route to the §9.5 channel.

DefaultLadder.description: Extension node (v1, Phase 4): the default ladder — rungs in descending priority; the highest rung that decides wins. Characteristic target: besluit (true = attribute, false = do-not-attribute); attribute target: consequentie (a leeg-evaluating consequence falls through); the initialisation rung (lowest) is justified iff the target is empty in the input.

verbindendeRol.description: Extension field (wire-entry discipline, IR-SPEC Method): the created-side role of the back-link, named explicitly — required where the type-pair derivation is role-ambiguous (a self-typed pair). Written whole or not at all, never null.

scopeRol.description: Extension field (wire-entry discipline, IR-SPEC Method): the scope-parent role of a parent-scoped uniqueness, named symbolically — the bound role is the role the scope hop reaches (its filler is the scope parent); the written scopeVeld must denote it. Written whole or not at all, never null.
